ex.kf.FTAtt: Play as Black and find the best move. The white king is on e1 and the white queen on b4.
ex.kf.FTAtt.hint: Look for a knight jump from e3 with check.
ex.kf.FTAtt.solution: 10...Nc2+! checks the king on e1 and attacks the queen on b4. After 11.Ke2, 11...Nxb4 captures the queen.
ex.kf.sZegi: Play as White and find the best move. The black king is on g8 and the black queen on d5.
ex.kf.sZegi.hint: Look for a knight jump from f5 with check.
ex.kf.sZegi.solution: 18.Ne7+! checks the king on g8 and attacks the queen on d5. After 18...Kh8, 19.Nxd5 captures the queen.
ex.kf.TMnM9: Play as White and find the best move. The black king is on f6 and the black rook on f2.
ex.kf.TMnM9.hint: Look for a knight jump from c3 with check.
ex.kf.TMnM9.solution: 46.Ne4+! checks the king on f6 and attacks the rook on f2. After 46...Kf7, 47.Nxf2 captures the rook.
ex.kf.MIfco: Play as Black and find the best move. The white queen is on d2 and the white rook on g1.
ex.kf.MIfco.hint: This fork has no check: look for the square that attacks the queen and the rook.
ex.kf.MIfco.solution: 26...Nf3! attacks the queen on d2 and the rook on g1. After 27.Qe3, saving the queen, 27...Nxg1 captures the rook.
ex.kf.3JvAn: Play as White and find the best move. The black queen is on h4 and the black bishop on d4.
ex.kf.3JvAn.hint: Look for the square that attacks the queen and the bishop, and think about Black's reply.
ex.kf.3JvAn.solution: 17.Nf3! attacks the queen on h4 and the bishop on d4. Black tries 17...Bxf2+, capturing a pawn with check and saving the bishop for one move; 18.Rxf2 recaptures, and the queen on h4 is still attacked.
ex.kf.QMUxc: Play as White and find the best move. The black queen is on d6 and the black rook on c7.
ex.kf.QMUxc.hint: Look for the square that attacks the queen and the rook, and think about Black's reply.
ex.kf.QMUxc.solution: 23.Nb5! attacks the queen on d6 and the rook on c7. Black answers 23...Rxc1, capturing a rook before losing the queen; 24.Nxd6 captures the queen.
ex.kf.zuWKT: Play as Black and find the best move. The white king is on e1, the white bishop on e3 and the white queen on c4.
ex.kf.zuWKT.hint: The bishop on e3 is undefended. Look for a knight move that attacks it.
ex.kf.zuWKT.solution: 17...Nxc2+! captures a pawn with check and attacks the bishop on e3. After 18.Kd2, 18...Nxe3 captures the bishop and attacks the queen on c4.
ex.kf.6FH0w: Play as White and find the best move. The black rook on a8 is in the sights of the queen on a4, but the black knight on c7 defends it.
ex.kf.6FH0w.hint: Your queen already attacks the rook on a8. Count its defenders.
ex.kf.6FH0w.solution: 11.Nxc7+! captures one of the defenders of the rook on a8, with check to the king on e8. After 11...Qxc7, the queen leaves d8, the rook is left undefended and 12.Qxa8+ captures it.
part.knightFork.title: Knight fork
part.knightFork.summary: The knight jumps and attacks two pieces at once; the fork works when a single move cannot save both.
